nodes.name: auth.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference pointing agents to the neon-auth skill for login/identity decisions (Managed Better Auth, existing Better Auth, or self-managed) and where to fetch its setup docs.

nodes.name: claimable-neon.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference for the Claimable Neon flow: provisioning a temporary Neon project before a human account exists, and the CLI/REST steps to later claim it into a real organization.

nodes.name: function-triggers.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference describing branch-scoped Function Triggers (cron schedules and storage-object-created events) and how to declare, list, or manage them via neon.ts, the CLI, MCP, or REST.

nodes.name: logs-loki.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference for reading branch-scoped Functions/Object-Storage logs via the CLI, the Loki-compatible read API, or the @neon/sdk paginated query iterator.

nodes.name: parse-env.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference for @neon/env's parseEnv helper, which validates and types environment variables against a neon.ts config, optionally scoped to a subset of required keys.

nodes.name: sdk.md
nodes.summary: Vendored Neon agent-skill reference introducing @neon/sdk, the official fetch-based, zero-dependency TypeScript client for the Neon API that succeeds the axios-based @neondatabase/api-client.
